name: Invoice Ninja
summary: Invoice Ninja offers unlimited invoicing for up to five clients on a free plan, and Ninja Pro costs $14 a month for unlimited clients. Clients pay from a client portal through gateways such as Stripe, PayPal and Square.

facts.text: The free plan covers 5 clients with unlimited invoices and excludes the REST API, automatic payment reminders and e-invoicing with PEPPOL.
All paid plans come with a 30-day money-back promise.
Named payment gateways are Stripe, PayPal, Square, GoCardless, Authorize.net and Mollie, and several can be connected at once.
After a partial payment the invoice updates with the remaining balance and a new due date.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 clients with unlimited invoices

plans.name: Ninja Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited clients. $140 a year on annual billing

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Priced by number of users, up to $300 a month for 51 to 100 users

hiddenCosts: Payment gateway fees are paid to the gateway; none are listed on the pricing page.
Removing Invoice Ninja branding and using a branded portal URL need a paid plan.
